name: Custom Python Brute-Force Script
description: When hydra/medusa can't model a custom auth flow (odd tokens, JSON, multi-step, numeric PINs), a short Python requests loop brute-forces it. Detect success by status code, response length, or a keyword.

variations.label: Numeric PIN brute (0000-9999)
Dictionary attack (POST)

notes: Success detection is the hard part - baseline a known-bad response first, then diff on status code, Content-Length, or a marker string ('Invalid'/'flag'). Add a session/CSRF-token fetch before each attempt if the app requires one. Thread with concurrent.futures for speed, but watch rate limits/lockout.

recommended.note: Use hydra when the form is standard.
